bibl.title: The Overseers of the Barns of Babylon: Two Arabic-Greek Receipts.
bibl.seg: 141.4 P. Heid. Inv. G 2160 = P. Christ. Musl. 3 141.4 / 141.8 P. Heid. Inv. Arab. 304 = P. Christ. Musl. 2 145.4 / 145.8 S.P.P. VIII, 1345 = P. Christ. Musl. 1
Lajos Berkes, James Cowey & Naïm Vanthieghem, The Overseers of the Barns of Babylon: Two Arabic-Greek Receipts.
Lajos Berkes (ed.), Christians and Muslims in Early Islamic Egypt = American Studies in Papyrology. 56 (Durham, NC, 2022) pp. 65-76, figg.
bibl.note: P. Christ. Musl. 1. A Bilingual Receipt from the Overseers of the Barns at Babylon: S.P.P. VIII, 1345 Reconsidered. Aphrodito (?), Dhū l-Qaʿda 87/October-November 706. - P. Christ. Musl. 2. Another Bilingual Receipt from the Overseers of the Barns at Babylon: An Edition of P. Heid.Inv. Arab. 304. Aphrodito (?), late 7th-early 8th century. - P. Christ. Musl. 3: Appendix: Greek Writing Exercises [with quotations from the Psalms] from an Early Islamic Administrative Office (P. Heid. Inv. G 2160). Provenance unknown, late 7th-early 8th century.
